crossRefs.note: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.
Samuel said to him, “Yahweh has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who…
David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your…
Afterward, David’s heart struck him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

people.name: Ahijah
people.line: Prophet from Shiloh who prophesied to Jeroboam

translations.web: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.
translations.bsb: And Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing, tore it into twelve pieces,
translations.kjv: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
translations.asv: And Ahijah laid hold of the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces.
